result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signals but lacks pedestrian-specific infrastructure like refuge islands or visible countdown signals. The wide roadway creates a long crossing distance, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic in a residential setting.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the conflict zone without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main thoroughfare in the foreground

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corners can block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection along the curb

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow for two-stage crossing and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the wide, open nature of the intersection increase exposure risk for those crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights.

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The rounded curb on the left may allow vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve clarity and safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for safe crossings. However, the lack of physical traffic calming and potential sightline obstructions from mature trees at the corner increase risk.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Mature trees and utility poles at the corner may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching or turning motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left corner near the signal pole

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes without a median refuge.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position for drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to allow pedestrians to enter the crosswalk before vehicle traffic is released.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks, providing a baseline level of safety. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Pedestrian Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a refuge island or curb extensions to shorten the distance.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk during crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a 3-7 second head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.
